Japan's Anthropic Usage Index is **1.91** for the period starting 2026-05-01. It ranks **32nd of 121** countries.

The index compares a country's share of Claude usage with its share of the working-age population. A value of 1.0 means usage exactly matches population size, which is also the global average. So Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population alone would predict.

For comparison with the global average:
- **Work, personal and coursework:** 47%, 47% and 6% in Japan, against 43%, 40% and 16% globally.
- **Augmentation and automation:** 53% and 47% in Japan, against 51% and 49% globally.

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index

To save a step, I called the country lookup directly and skipped the country list and subregion tools. I also had to use the tool-search step once to load the econ index tool before I could call it.
